snippet.title: AlcheMice - Official Demo Launch Trailer | DevGamm Awards 2026
snippet.description:
Check out the Demo Release Trailer for AlcheMice, a tactical roguelite deckbuilder developed by Red Mountain. Every card is a tarot card, and players move across hand-designed, grid-based dungeons inspired by 15th-century GranAdah, strike with action cards, brew alchemy into your deck and survive traps, loot and enemies that change every run, playing movement cards that work like chess pieces: the knight’s jump clears traps and reaches high ground. Each run lasts three complete days before the loop resets at dawn, and players keep only their deck and whatever they locked in the chest. 

AlcheMice is coming in 2027 to PC (Steam), with a wishlist available now.
